SURVEY_VS_EXTRACTION_NOTE: 22 chapters surveyed; 226 worked charts located; 131 records extracted into the corpus. Where `extracted` < `charts`, the shortfall is DELIBERATE SELECTION under §5's 'quality beats count', not a retrieval failure: priority went to charts carrying explicit strength/capacity vocabulary, all matched pairs, all counterexamples, and every 從/假從/從兒 case. The unextracted remainder is available for S2 at the URLs recorded here and was not discarded.

TITLE: 淵海子平

KNOWN_SCHOOL_BIAS: Older 格局/神煞-inclusive stratum; presence-based disqualifiers (見庚辛即官殺，非此格也).
STATUS: EXAMINED — DOCTRINE/TERMINOLOGY role confirmed; deliberately NOT used as a worked-case source
EDITION: sajumania 黃文塗堪輿研究中心 7-volume traditional-character e-text (304 chapters). The Wikisource copy is an ABRIDGED edition MISSING 外十八格, 雜格 and 神趣八法 entirely.

KNOWN_EDITORIAL_LAYER: 眉批 are mnemonic verse, NOT analytic commentary
KEY_FINDINGS: 專旺 ABSENT — full-text scan plus a sitewide insource search that DID return 三命通會, which makes the negative meaningful rather than a search artefact
Binary glyph-presence disqualifiers: 要不見庚辛之氣，見庚辛即官殺，非此格也 — categorically unlike 滴天髓 balance-of-forces reasoning
ROOT BLOCKS FOLLOWING, stated 3x independently: 日主有根則不可棄，主貧。無根棄之則富 / 忌日主有根及比肩之地 / 或有根者不吉 → CF-011, makes R11 SCHOOL_DEPENDENT

Strength as an admission gate: 類屬要身旺，而從化要衰也
甲乙日得亥卯未局… is in 三命通會 卷六, NOT here — prior attribution corrected

TITLE: 三命通會
RELIABILITY_NOTES: 四庫 text systematically writes 巳 for 己 (戊巳 = 戊己, 巳土 = 己土, and 己酉丑 printed for 巳酉丑 in 從革) — pervasive, not meaningful. Variant glyphs throughout (尅/剋, 湏/須, 逄/逢, 夘/卯, 刄/刃). EDITION DIVERGENCE: 四庫 懷金氣 vs 8bei8 坏(壞)金氣 — a real semantic split; 懷 is likely correct. BOTH editions print 戊己生逄四月中 where sense demands 四季 — an inherited error, not OCR.
STATUS: EXAMINED — 卷七 identified as the best worked-case material; 卷八-九 excluded as interpolated
COMMENTATOR: 萬民英 own interlinear commentary in 〈…〉 on reprinted earlier 賦/歌 (卷十一-十二)
EDITION: 四庫全書本 via zh.wikisource 全覽 — entire 12 卷 on one page, 478,094 chars, traditional, unpunctuated, 四庫 orthography. Cross-collated against 8bei8 modern punctuated edition.
CHAPTER_STRUCTURE: 12 卷. 卷一-二 definitional (納音, 十二宮, 旺相休囚死). 卷三 神煞. 卷四 day-stem x month. 卷五-六 格局 catalogue (~90 named). 卷七 論女命. 卷八-九 a 60 day-pillar x 12 hour lookup table (~720 rubrics, ~22% of the book). 卷十 㸔命口訣 — the ONLY sustained statement of method. 卷十一-十二 earlier 賦/歌 with 萬 commentary.
CASE_DENSITY: HIGH but BIMODAL. Narrated cases with reasoning ~60-90 in 478k chars (LOW for the size). Tabulated cases (name + year + month only, no reasoning) number in the hundreds and dominate 卷八-九.
REASONING_DENSITY: LOW-TO-MODERATE and highly uneven. Median chart gets 15-40 chars (合格大貴 / 殺豬屠戶). EXCEPTION: 卷七 論女命 routinely gives 60-120 chars of connected 十神 reasoning — the best material in the book.
STRENGTH_TERMINOLOGY: MEASURED over 478,094 chars: 身旺 463, 納音 223, 身弱 202, 日主 217, 用神 173, 月令 165, 神煞 86, 格局 83, 得令 27, 通根 5. READ HONESTLY: 身旺 is very high but functions as an ALREADY-KNOWN LOCAL FACT (身旺逢官 / 行身旺運), while 通根 at 5 shows the work has almost NO vocabulary for ESTABLISHING strength by root.
SPECIAL_PATTERN_TERMINOLOGY: 曲直 炎上 從革 潤下 稼穡 as five CONSECUTIVE but UNGROUPED and COLLECTIVELY UNNAMED sections in 卷六, keyed to day-stem pair + 三合局. 從煞 28x, 從財 9x, filed among 十神 sections not with the mono-element forms. 專旺 9x but ALWAYS ADJECTIVAL — there is NO 專旺格.
KNOWN_LINEAGE: Ming encyclopedic compendium; 納音 is a live first-class channel (223 occurrences, more than 月令 or 格局)
KNOWN_EDITORIAL_LAYER: ⚠️ 卷八-九 official rosters are PARTLY LATER COMMERCIAL-PRINT INTERPOLATION. The 四庫 editors flagged it in 1779 (中間所載仕宦八字往往及明季之人葢後來坊刻所攙入亦己非原本之舊) and one entry names the 天啓 era (1621-27), decades after 萬民英 died. DO NOT treat 卷八-九 as his own case files.
CHARTS_LOCATED: 60+ narrated (lower bound, scanned only for the 一命 marker); hundreds tabulated
SEX_MARKERS: 乾造 0 occurrences; 坤造 1 and NOT a chart marker (乾坤造化各主禍福). This work has NO 乾造/坤造 notation. All charts NOT_STATED, EXCEPT that everything in 卷七 falls under 論女命 and is female BY SECTION CONTEXT — recorded as such, never inferred from pillars.
LUCK_CYCLES: No chart carries a printed 大運 sequence. A minority mention a single luck pillar inline (運行壬午, 一交丁巳運).
KEY_FINDINGS: 旺相休囚死 IS EXPLICITLY NOT AN EVALUATIVE SCALE: 見生旺者未必便作吉論見休囚死絶未必便作凶言 — then re-purposed as a corrective trigger: 生旺太過宜乎制伏死絶不及宜乎生扶 → OBS-20
PRIMARY FRAME: 凡㸔命專以日干為主取提綱所用之物為命 … 曰官曰印曰財曰煞曰食神曰傷官以此六法消息之. Relation-to-relation rules (逢官㸔財逢煞㸔印), not strength computation.
專旺 present 9x but NEVER as a 格 name — always adjectival. The 卷四 hit groups the forms under 類象: 若成趨乾曲直類象等格 → completes the 專旺 provenance chain
曲直 entry gated on a 十神 RELATION not an element count: 甲乙日得亥卯未局柱中湏有亥字帶印為入格 (VERIFIED, both editions)
稼穡 passage is a QUOTATION: 〈賦雲〉戊巳忻逄四季乃為稼穡之名 — 萬民英 is citing an earlier 賦, not authoring it. Attribution corrected.
四庫 editors 1779 named the organizing axes as 官印財祿食傷之名義 / 用神之輕重 / 諸神煞所係之吉凶 — and conspicuously did NOT name day-master strength

TITLE: 窮通寶鑑 (欄江網 / 造化元鑰)
COMMENTATOR: 徐樂吾 評註 (1937) — SEPARATE LAYER, registered as SRC-006
ERA: base text Qing or earlier; 徐樂吾 commentary 1937
EDITION: zh.wikisource 窮通寶鑑, base text only, 34140 chars, PD banner. Corroborated by 8bei8, sajumania, guwendao and suanzhun — ALL are base-text-only witnesses.
ACCESS_NOTE: 徐樂吾 評註 is NOT obtainable online as text. The authoritative 1937 千頃堂 edition exists as a National Library of China scan on Wikimedia Commons (NLC416-12jh004238-48608) but is image-only JBIG2 with no text layer.
CHAPTER_STRUCTURE: 五行總論 → 十干分論 → 論木/火/土/金/水 → per-stem → 三春/三夏/三秋/三冬 → per-month entries (正月甲木 etc). The primary key of the entire work is STEM x MONTH. There is no chapter on 格局, none on 用神取法, and none on strength assessment.
CASE_DENSITY: HIGH by count (183 chart headers 時日月年 across 72 tables, ~1 per 190 chars) but NEAR-ZERO analysed — labels are 2-6 chars (狀元/按察/詞林/進士) and most charts carry no label at all
REASONING_DENSITY: HIGH in doctrinal prose (explicit condition → element → outcome chains); NEAR-ZERO in the case layer
STRENGTH_TERMINOLOGY: MEASURED over the full text: 身強 0, 扶抑 0, 旺衰 0, 得勢 0, 黨眾 0, 助寡 0, 調候 0. 身弱 10 and 身輕 7 occur ONLY inside frozen idioms (財多身弱, 殺重身輕) or quoted 口訣/歌訣, governed by 名/名曰 — pattern NAMES, not derivations.
CLIMATE_TERMINOLOGY: 寒 75, 旺 87 (mostly of ELEMENTS, not the self), 暖 25, 凍 22, 燥 17, 焚 6, 濕 3. Named conditions: 寒木向陽, 金弱沉寒, 解凍, 愈寒愈凍, 燥渴相加, 太陽失令, 冬至一陽生弱中復強.
SPECIAL_PATTERN_TERMINOLOGY: 棄命從殺 appears (十一月丙火); no systematic special-pattern taxonomy
KNOWN_LINEAGE: climatic / seasonal lineage — though the base text NEVER uses the word 調候
KNOWN_EDITORIAL_LAYER: the circulating digital text is the bare 余春臺 recension; the 徐樂吾 layer is absent from every located witness
RELIABILITY_NOTES: Textual variant flagged: 五月庚金 reads 又見戊己透者則吉 on Wikisource and 則否 on 8bei8. 則否 is consistent with the preceding 切忌戊己透干制水、則否; 則吉 reverses the sense. UNRESOLVED — do not rely on that clause.
SEX_MARKERS: NOT_STATED throughout, with exactly ONE exception: the 十二月庚金 chart 癸庚己庚 / 未戌丑辰 is labelled 女命. Never inferred anywhere.
STATUS: EXAMINED — DOCTRINE/TERMINOLOGY role confirmed; deliberately NOT used as a worked-case source
KEY_FINDINGS: A COMPLETE CLASSICAL SYSTEM WITH NO STRENGTH AXIS: 身強 / 扶抑 / 旺衰 / 得勢 / 黨眾 / 助寡 all measure ZERO → OBS-17
調候 appears ZERO times in the book the term names → OBS-18
Climate prescribes what 扶抑 forbids: 五月庚金 is 庚金敗地 yet 專用壬水 with 切忌戊己透干制水; 十一月丙火 is the weakest Fire yet 壬水為最, justified calendrically by 冬至一陽生，弱中復強 → CF-013
Its own selection rule ignores the self: 木旺宜庚，水旺宜戊，火旺用壬
FALSE FRIEND: 得時 here means seasonally-timed (水火二物，要得時相濟為美), NOT the strength sense
FALSE FRIEND: 金弱沉寒 — 弱 inside a CLIMATIC pattern name, remedied by 丙火照暖 rather than by reinforcement

TITLE: 子平真詮評註 — 徐樂吾 commentary layer ONLY
BASE_TEXT_AUTHOR: 沈孝瞻 (base text is SRC-002, a different authority)
WHY_SEPARATE_SOURCE_ID: This layer must never be conflated with 沈孝瞻. It is the earliest located locus of the 扶抑-baseline + 調候-supplement framing that modern standard doctrine inherits. Registering it separately is what makes that inheritance visible instead of invisible.
ACCESS_LOCATION: https://www.suanzhun.net/book/326.html — 論用神配氣候得失, layers explicitly labelled 原文: / 徐注:
STRENGTH_TERMINOLOGY: On ch.14 alone: 調候 13, 中和 4, 身弱 2, 扶抑 1. Compare the base 窮通寶鑑: 調候 0, 扶抑 0. Uses 身弱 as a LIVE DIAGNOSIS DRIVING A SELECTION (更有調候雖得其宜而身弱者…須以酉金扶身為用) — a grammar absent from both classical texts measured.
KEY_FINDINGS: THE SYSTEMATIZATION SENTENCE, verified verbatim with layer attribution: 故取用神，於扶抑之外，必須參合氣候，即調候之法也。 — it names 調候, installs 扶抑 as the baseline, and subordinates climate to it
凡八字必以中和為貴，偏旺一方，而無調劑之神，雖成格成局，亦不為美 — a QUANTITATIVE balance doctrine, where 窮通寶鑑 uses 中和 to mean THERMALLY TEMPERATE
Supplies analysed cases with named subjects that the base texts lack (e.g. 彭玉麟 造 丙子/辛丑/戊子/癸丑)
COPYRIGHT: 徐樂吾 d.1948 — likely PD under life+70, but modern typeset editions may carry their own claim. SHORT EXCERPTS ONLY.
RELIABILITY_NOTES: GAP: 徐樂吾 own 窮通寶鑑評註 (1937) could not be read — the NLC scan is image-only JBIG2. The evidence here is from his 子平真詮評註 (1936). The inference that he applies the same framing in the 窮通寶鑑 commentary is STRONG BUT NOT DIRECTLY MEASURED.

TITLE: 神峰通考 (命理正宗)
COMMENTATOR: 張楠 own voice, signed 楠曰, PLUS an unsigned 注釋/補曰 commentary layer of separate provenance
EDITION: zh.wikisource raw wikitext (453,298 B / 156,770 chars of book text) cross-checked against 8bei8.com (115 pages). Both are ONE simplified digitization, not independent witnesses — share errors verbatim (雕桔 for 凋枯, 印緩 for 印綬). A photographic NLC scan exists (Wikimedia Commons NLC416-13jh001619-43305) but has NOT been OCRd.
CHAPTER_STRUCTURE: 卷一-卷六 (some digital splits present 4 juan). Fixed case shape: eight characters -> label naming pattern AND defect -> a 七言 verse -> prose naming 病, 藥, and luck-pillar outcomes with ages and causes of death.
CASE_DENSITY: THE HIGHEST-VALUE NEW CORPUS FOUND IN S1.6. 307 four-pillar chart occurrences, 296 distinct (~2 charts/1000 chars). 142 blocks signed 楠曰 (張楠 own voice, median 178 chars); 132 charts followed within 120 chars by 楠曰, 74 by 補曰, 46 by 此造, 16 by 此命.
REASONING_DENSITY: HIGH in the 楠曰 layer -- dense causal 病/藥 reasoning with named subjects (276 of 305 charts carry a person/rank marker, many locatable: 嚴嵩 matches his attested birth year).
STRENGTH_TERMINOLOGY: 扶抑 = 0 occurrences. Content renamed 損/益, demoted to two of张楠 own four "medicines". 中和 = 47, 用神 = 58. 專旺 = exactly 2, BOTH glossing an unrelated 喜忌篇 line (食神干旺之方), one explicitly reported as an inherited 舊注 label, not 張楠 coinage. 從旺 = 0.
